balls.text: and a slow and wide full toss to end with, he cannot enough bat on it, and only a single is taken as the ball rolls away on the off side
tries to lift this pitched up delivery straight but gets it on the bounce to long off, there have not been many length balls to hit from the Delhi fast men
slams a pitched up ball straight down the pitch, Aaron gets a hand out and takes pace off it, down to long off
length ball outside off, but Hussey cannot drag it wide of midwicket, takes the single now
cannot connect as he swings at a full delivery angled into him, off the pad to short third, Hussey turns down the leg bye
back of a length into the batsman, takes one hand off the bat handle as he awkwardly gets it down to fine leg
Morne gets the yorker on target, Hussey jams his bat down on it, Morne sprawls flat across the pitch to stop the ball, not a dive, he is so tall he does not need to dive
full and wide outside off, he gets bat to it and drills it well wide of sweeper cover
backs away to a low full toss and squeezes it out to sweeper cover
full toss edged on the bounce to the keeper outside leg
direct hit at the striker's end from Aaron at extra cover, and it has caught PK just short, PK wasn't exactly charging across for the run, Hussey cannot believe that PK did not make it
almost did him with a slower length ball, PK reached out and inside edged it through square leg
more runs for PK, this time he decides to clear front leg and throw his bat at one outside off, thick edge gives no chance to third man, one-bounce four, Umesh shakes his head
pushed away to extra cover
he tried the short delivery angled into the batsman, but it carries down the leg side, PK did not back away this time
the other PK now, makes room outside leg and has a slog, misses, by miles
not a bad short from PK at all, he stands calmly and powers a length ball through point, sweeper cover just managed to stop it inside the rope
Ojha has taken another fine catch tonight, Chawla backed away outside leg and swung at this length ball, thick edge flew to Ojha's left, he reacted quickly to pouch it safely as he tumbled down
he was trying to do it all the time earlier, this time he manages to clear front leg and get enough bat on this pitched up ball to send it over long on
squeezes out this full and widish delivery over point, but not much timing on it, and sweeper cover fields
again gets it very full, not easy to hit those, drilled to long off
moves a long way outside leg stump, and slices this length ball to point, direct hit would have tested Hussey
goes for the yorker, not quite in the blockhole but difficult to get under even as he makes room, down to long on
backs away outside leg and mistimes the length ball weakly over the bowler for a single to long on
good end to the over, fools him with a slower one that moves in past his swing
Irfan escapes again, Chawla clobbers a full delivery straight to sweeper cover
cannot get the placement this time, clears front leg and drills a full delivery to long off
bottom edge to the keeper as he tries to make room and slog this one away
Irfan's innocuous pace taken for four over the bowler's head, pitched up around middle and Hussey lifts it in the air
waits for a slower one in the middle of his bat-swing and hits it to sweeper cover
big backlift as he drives a full delivery to long off
pushed down the ground for one
pushed back to the bowler
leans forward and pushes this pitched up delivery back to the bowler, who does not field it cleanly, they think of the single, but the ball hasn't rolled far from the bowler
controls the pull off this short ball, deep square gets around to it
hits a pitched up ball angled in from around the stumps, to mid off
length ball firmly pushed past the bowler to long off
wanted to have a go at a length ball outside off but it was the slower one and he hits it into the pitch
back of a length, he pushes away from the body, on the bounce to point
punches this length delivery on off past extra cover
neat from Hussey, stays in the crease, opens the face and softly runs the length ball down to the third man rope, Aaron's dive is in vain
pitched up full on middle, swung away in front of square leg
eased down to long on past the bowler

excellent comeback from Negi, Gurkeerat is in the mood to go after everything, Negi this time does not give him pace, he slows it up, flights it nicely, draws Gurkeerat out and into a loose drive way inside the line, and gets it to spin away for Ojha to complete the stumping
now he wristily lifts it over midwicket, it was fired into the pads, Gurkeerat gets forward, and drills it over midwicket, back leg in the air
well done, Gurkeerat gets going with a confident stride forward, and a well-timed loft over extra cover
square drives it but point stops it to his right
pushes a tossed up full delivery onto the leg side, bowler fields
that beats Hussey, it has taken off from back of a length at 147.8 kph and held its line too just outside off

that looked as a clean a hit as any as it sped off the bat from a full length, but Irfan has got in the way at long off, he is not far from the rope as he moves to his right, times the leap superbly to take the catch, and ensures he does not trod onto the rope as he comes down
this time he has got hold of the pull, Umesh drops it short outside off at 145.7 kph, Mahmood fetches it and sends it racing through midwicket
goes after a 144.8 kph back of a length ball, and manages to heave it over mid on
he is trying to make room often, is cramped this time by a back of a length ball and pushes it to mid on
angled full into the pads, and neatly picked away in the air to deep square
flat and straightening outside off, bit of width, Hussey backs away and creates more, and times the cut to the deep point rope

Punjab are giving the fielders a chance with their running, hesitation in going for the single as Mahmood pushes a tossed up ball to point, fielder also hesitates in deciding which end to go for, he settles on the keeper's, by that time, Hussey, who had stopped midway, has made his ground
fired in full on middle, eased down to long off
spinning away outside off, runs it to short third man for one
flat and angled in on off, punched to sweeper cover
played off the back foot towards point
played off the pads on the leg side

there's a mix-up between the batsmen and Miller has to go. Hussey smashed the ball to mid-on, he hit it very hard. Miller set off from the non-striker's end but there was no single there. Hussey sent him back, but Miller had already come a long way down. He was caught well short by the direct hit from Negi. Maybe Miller thought the fielder was at long on?
steered off the back foot towards point
short of a length outside off, and quick, Hussey stays in his crease, fishes, and is beaten
fuller length and straight, worked off the pads through square
misses as he tries to steer it past point, some bounce for Irfan
tucks a back of a length ball in front of midwicket
covers for the away swing as he drives off the front foot, straight to extra cover
thick edge along the ground now down to third man
fuller, and moving in, pushed down the pitch, Irfan cannot stop it, mid off does
swings in but gently from a good length just outside off, and he can stay in the crease, allow it to come on and time it past point
they go for the second and get it, deep square leg running in cannot stop the ball cleanly, it was swung away off a thick inside edge
pitched up on middle and off, defended solidly
beaten again, this time on the pull to a short ball outside off
now he has the left-hander pushing outside the line of one moving in to him from a good length, not far from off stump as well

Sehwag had posted himself at wide slip, and he pouches yet another sharp catch, just about manages to hold onto it in the right hand, Saini done in by the away movement on Umesh's good length ball, pushed at it but got a thick edge
swing for Umesh right away at 138.9 kph, full outside off, draws him into the drive, and beats him
pulls a flat and angled delivery to deep midwicket
angled into him, and rushes in with the angle, he was making room, but could not work it away
pushed away to sweeper cover
Mahela dives at extra cover and saves the single
thick edge as he goes for a drive, the ball races to the third man rope
flat and wide outside off, he reaches out to slap it to covers
that has been neatly dabbed past point, and Morkel runs across from third man, puts in the dive and saves the boundary
wide and slow at 122.1 kph, but he does not drive in the air, checks his shot a bit, ball goes to cover
could that have been another one? Hussey drives first ball, and Warner got to it at point before it rolls away, did that carry?

Sehwag is not the fastest on the field, but he is a very safe catcher anywhere on it, here he takes out Mandeep with a low tumbling catch at short midwicket, Mandeep lived by the pull, he's fallen by it, did not time it this time, and that allowed Sehwag some time to react to the stroke
pushes a full delivery towards mid on who slides across to field
into the pads at 138.1 kph and he shuffles to flick it over and in front of square leg
and as solid in defence as he was on the pull, smothers the length ball with a confident forward stride
he's pulled well, and he does so again, gets on top of the bounce on the short delivery and controls the pull through midwicket
pitched up right on to middle and off, he gets forward late and scoops it towards extra cover
more width, shorter too, and he cracks the cut past a diving backward point, Warner it is who manages to get a hand to it
goes after this one outside off, and the thick edge flies over and well past the wide slip
awkwardly defends a length ball which bounces at him
holds its line from back of a length just outside off at 144.4 kph, beats him
inside edge onto pad prevented a big lbw appeal off the length ball, there is a direct hit by Warner at the non-striker's but replays show he has just made his ground
full again and a fine drive this time, beats the bowler as he gets his hand down, but mid off gets across to his right and dives to save the four, Negi it is
pushes one pitched full on the stumps to the bowler
143.3 kph pitched up ball headed for middle and off, defended just in time

Marsh has been given caught down the leg side, and Aaron has struck first ball, Aaron angled it  in from around the stumps, it was headed down the leg side, Marsh tried to turn it fine but ended up getting something on it for the keeper to take a diving catch to his right, seemed to be bit of both bat and thigh pad
in the air but just out of the reach of square leg
huge appeal from Morne, and a long one too, he went on imploring umpire Dharmasena, who walked away without fuss, the back of a length ball pitched just outside leg though
tall Morne hurls in a 146.8 kph yorker from the heavens, Marsh does really well to jam his bat down on it
angled outside off now, but he pushes it tamely to point from the crease
bounces into him from back of a length on leg, he takes it on the body as he is cramped for room
Morne begins with a tight length ball around off, defended awkwardly
to deep midwicket for a single
more runs, the Rao experiment not working, wide again, flat again, short again, Marsh crashes it through cover
flights it fullish on off, defended
bit of flight this time, widish again, and short enough for him to stay in the crease and cut it past cover
wide delivery outside off, pushed to cover
starts off with an innocuous flat and shortish one outside off, Marsh puts it away through extra cover
pulled away for a one-bounce four over midwicket, the ball swung in, but from back of a length, and Mandeep was ready, he has been really eager to play the pull this IPL
moves forward and pushes one going across him, pushes it to short extra cover
pitches it on leg stump and gets it to straighten, hit on the pad as he misses the work to leg
moving away, but fuller this time, and Marsh reaches out to push it to short extra cover
Marsh beaten with the movement away from him outside off stump, takes a step forward, is hesitant as he pokes at the ball leaving him
swing into the right-hander first up, from a good length, but going down the leg side and tucked fine
that will be it, Mahela has dragged another short ball into the gap between midwicket and mid on
Mahela gets to fifty, he was looking to make room initially, Mahmood followed him with a back of a length ball, Mahela recovered quickly to swat-pull it through square leg, despite being off-balance
drilled, and it disappears past extra cover, legs wide apart, solid base created to power the full delivery away
pitched up and eased back down the ground to long on
now he finds point once again, he made room outside leg stump, and cut, Irfan went for the single
that should have gone, short, wide, but Mahela has tried to time it rather than hit it, and it goes straight to point
how clean is this from Irfan, Awana's line has been awry this over, now this one is full on the pads, and Irfan swings it powerfully in front of square leg
Irfan doing it, there was width this time outside off, the ball was pitched up, and Irfan smoked it off the front foot, one bounce to the deep extra cover rope

and again, almost, Irfan gets the swing going again, and the pitched up ball is timed even better this time, deep square somehow manages to stop the four, he cannot do it cleanly though, and Irfan gets back in time for the second
deep square leg cannot stop this one with a dive, straight and shortish, and Irfan swats it behind square
Irfan tries to launch him through extra cover but there wasn't enough room to play that shot, the ball bounced as well
stays in the crease and slaps a nippy length ball past extra cover
does not get hold of the pull as he goes at the sharp short delivery, the ball pops up towards square leg
pushes a length ball calmly for a single to mid off
swung off the pads again, but not timed well enough this time, to deep square
that will go, short and on to the pads with the angle, and Mahela swings it eagerly wide of fine leg
opened up as this pitched up ball straightens on off stump, awkwardly pats it back to PK
short of a length, worked off the pads to fine leg
how on earth, but it is a maiden, from Piyush Chawla to Mahela, flat and wide outside off stump, should have sped away past point, but the cut went straight to the fielder
can he bowl a maiden? Mahela cannot push this one past the bowler
Chawla coming back nicely, Mahela feeling the pressure, he tries to sweep from well outside off, and misses once again
and an appeal for leg before now, turned down, hit him comfortably outside the line, it was pushed through in with the angle, Mahela defended outside the line
tossed up again, Mahela looks to drive it, misses again
tries to run a tossed up legbreak to third man but misses as it turns away
length ball eased with a very straight bat to long on
Mahela wants the second, he has to rush back, and also has to dive in, makes it in the end, a stronger throw from third man and he was gone, Mahela had deftly dabbed it late wide of PK at third man
short and wide again, Mahela abandons all niceties and goes hard at it, Mandeep runs across and dives to save the four
worked off the pads to deep backward square
shortish and wide outside off, slapped away to sweeper cover
pushes one going across him firmly off the front foot to sweeper cover
Chawla smiles at the irony, a long hop gets him a wicket, Ojha smashes it straight to Mandeep at deep midwicket, he does not mess up, takes it safely just inside the rope
turning away wide outside off, Mahela hangs his bat out, but will get only one to short third man
pushed through full, Mahela gets forward and drills it hard past extra cover, sweeper cover had no chance, that just flew along the ground
pushed down the ground to long on
pushed back to the bowler
full on the legs, turned behind square
opens the face very late and earns a single to third man
Mahela gets one away now, on top of the bounce as he pulls in the gap in front of square

oh Piyush, after getting hit around, he now drops a sitter at long on, he got around to the ball in time to his left, went for it at around chest height with upturned wrists, and it popped out, Ojha had gone after the slower pitched up ball but not got enough on it
and again, this one is pitched up and angled in, he opens the face, and finds point for the third time
tries to steer it to third man as it comes in from outside off, cannot get it past point
cuts in from back of a length outside off, he allows it to come on and runs it to point
cracks a slow full toss straight to wide long off
wide outside off, Ojha slashes at it, and the thick edge flies well wide of the keeper, Hussey grimaces
swivels and pulls this harmless shortish ball to fine leg
cuts in from outside off, Ojha manages to dink it off an inside edge in front of cover for a sharp single, Mahela completes the runs and applauds his partner
he is a clean striker of the ball, and has been in good touch this domestic season, gets forward and lifts a length ball over extra cover
without fuss, Mahela opens the face and takes the single to third man
more punishment for Chawla, Ojha reaches out to a tossed up ball just outside off and smokes it hard way over long off
Ojha gets this one away, chips down the track, gets too close to the line and the pitch, but still he enough space to swing it cleanly down the ground
drives off the front foot, in the air for a while, away to sweeper cover
length ball dabbed to the off side for one
flights it wide and full outside off, Mahela goes for the drive, mistimes it completely, direct hit from extra cover would have tested Mahela
nudged down the pitch, Chawla gets around to it
cannot do anything more than move forward and push to short extra cover
pushed towards midwicket
bounce beats Ojha on the cut, that bounced a lot
half-swatted, half-helped away to deep square
driven very straight down the pitch to the bowler
back of a length ball steered to third man
now shortish and wide, cut away to point, who dives and parries it to sweeper cover
they will target Chawla, pushed through quick and full on the stumps, Ojha carts it down the ground, Marsh gets to it, but cannot stop it
hit through vacant midwicket, Chawla goes after the ball, man from the deep gets to it first, only one allowed
this time he lets it rip with flight, sharp turn away as Mahela misses the steer
flat, short and wide, Mahela puts them away all the time for Sri Lanka, dabbed between backward point and short third
tossed up very full and swatted away wide of sweeper cover
hit on the pad as he misses the work on leg, looked to be going down leg
gets bat around pad to flick the pitched up ball with the angle to fine leg
though of the pull, but the short ball moved away slowly well outside off, and Mahela abandoned the stroke
defends a nippy length ball towards cover, and takes off, has to turn back as the throw comes in, they will get the single for the overthrow
ending on middle and off from a good length, defended awkwardly towards cover
bounce, lots of it outside off, Ojha brings it down safely
carries in with the angle from a length now, worked to midwicket off the front foot
excellent from PK, angled in on a good length, Ojha has to play at it, but it then curls away sharply to beat him by several inches
uncertainly forward and nudges this length ball towards midwicket
tries to work it to leg from well outside off, takes it on the pad
well forward to smother a length ball
defended off the front foot
now he beats Ojha outside off, Ojha tries to drive a length ball
rides the bounce and defends a short of a length ball

Taylor does not look happy, but there was a sound again, boy, is this lad Awana sharp off the pitch, draws Taylor into a poke with one that holds its line outside off stump, and the thin edge is taken by the keeper
misses as he looks to squeeze out a very full one outside off
there was a sound, and he has been given, Awana continues to impress, Rao trying to drive a straightish good length ball, gets a feather through to the keeper
works a nippy back of a length ball off middle to square leg
gets well forward and defends a length ball
tries to cut one coming in with the angle, too close to the body as well, mistimes it
sharp single taken with a soft push on the off side
holds its line from short of a length on off, part thick outside edge, part open face to third man
worked wide of mid on for one
length ball worked off the pad to vacant midwicket
gets forward to a length ball outside off and pushes to short extra cover
length ball right on off stump, Mahela defends solidly
135.9 kph bouncer outside off, he allows it to go past
Mahela with a lovely cut stroke, width given, and Mahela puts it away off the front foot past backward point

game on, Awana is celebrating, before anyone else realises what has happened, he sees that the off bail has come off, a sharp back of a length ball coming in, Sehwag misses as he looks to work it to leg, it clips the off bail off the pad, Hussey throws his arms up in relief
mistimes an attempted cut into the ground, not that short a delivery

David Hussey has dropped Sehwag at mid on, a mistimed pull carried at a good height to Hussey, who went for it the conventional Australian way, the reverse cup, it popped out, he made another attempt but it was too late by then, Sehwag smiles broadly
softly pushed with a straight bat from close to the body for a single on the off side
they have been guilty of providing too much width, Rao cuts off the front foot, in the air and safely over point
stays in the crease as the length ball comes in to the pads, clipped to midwicket, Sehwag has to hurry as the throw comes in

Warner is gone, nothing shot, went a touch casually at this short of a length wide delivery that seemed to move away slightly, ended up playing a sot of flat-batted waft in the end, top-edge is taken by Mahmood around gully
he went for the straight drive to the pitched up ball but hit it to mid off in the end, Mahmood smiles
holds its line from back of a length outside off, he runs it to point
full into the pads and flicked crisply in front of square, there is a man in the deep there
surprised with this bouncer now, 132.2 kph, well-directed, at the shoulder, Warner fends at it, and somehow it goes fine down the leg side
slowish bouncer sails over just down the leg side
shortish, and width given again to Warner, he stays in the crease and powers it between extra cover and cover
pushes a length ball to wide mid off
this one will go, pitched up, angled in towards the pads, and Sehwag swings it cleanly and powerfully over wide long on
this one straightens from back of a length, he opens up and plays it carefully from the crease
hit on the pad first ball which swings in, PK appeals, but he is not getting it, Sehwag has managed an inside edge as he heaved at the ball
short and angled in, he swivels to pull it to deep square
width, too much of it, and Warner swats the length ball past extra cover
Sehwag nearly gets into trouble first ball, Warner stays back and pushes this length ball on the leg side, PK goes after it, Sehwag wants the single, he has to turn back from halfway up the pitch
